units.source_text: 日色渐暮，薰大将才离开洞隙，穿好衣服，照例召唤弁君到那纸隔扇边，向她探问情况。

en.t: As daylight gradually faded, General Kaoru finally left the opening in the cave, put his clothes in order, and as usual summoned Ben no Kimi to the paper sliding screen to ask her about the situation.

units.source_text: 他说：“我来得正好，却是可喜。

en.t: He said, "It is fortunate that I came at just the right time.

units.source_text: 托你的事怎么样了？”

en.t: How has the matter I entrusted to you gone?"

units.source_text: 老尼姑答道：“自从大人吩咐之后，我就静候适当机会。

en.t: The old nun replied, "Ever since Your Lordship gave me your instructions, I have been quietly waiting for a suitable opportunity.

units.source_text: 去年匆匆过去了。

en.t: Last year passed by in a rush.

units.source_text: 今年二月小姐赴初濑进香，道经此地，我始得和她见面。

en.t: In the second month of this year, the young lady went on pilgrimage to Hatsuse and passed this way, so I was finally able to meet her.

units.source_text: 那时我就把大人的意思隐约告知她母亲。

en.t: At that time I hinted at Your Lordship's intentions to her mother.

units.source_text: 她母亲说：‘叫她代替大女公子，实在是诚惶诚恐，不敢当的。’

en.t: Her mother said, 'To have her take the place of the elder princess is truly too great an honor, and we could not presume to accept it.'

units.source_text: 但那时候我闻知大人很忙，未便谈及此事，所以不曾把她这话转达。

en.t: But at that time I heard that Your Lordship was very busy, and it seemed inconvenient to raise the matter, so I did not pass on her words.

units.source_text: 本月小姐又去进香，今日方才回来。

en.t: This month the young lady went on pilgrimage again, and only returned today.

units.source_text: 她归途中到此泊宿，和我亲昵，也只是为了怀念旧日情缘之故。

en.t: On her way back she stopped here for the night, and her warmth toward me is only because she remembers our old ties with affection.

units.source_text: 但此次她母亲有事未便同行，只有小姐一人出门，所以我没有告诉她大人在此。”

en.t: But this time her mother had business and could not accompany her, so the young lady traveled alone, and I did not tell her that Your Lordship was here."

units.source_text: 薰大将说：“我也不愿叫乡下人看见我这便服微行的姿态，所以诫告随从人等不可说出。

en.t: General Kaoru said, "I too do not want the country people to see me traveling incognito in plain dress, so I warned my attendants not to speak of it.

units.source_text: 然而很难说，那些底下人未见得会隐瞒到底吧。

en.t: Still, one cannot be sure; people of that sort may not be able to keep it hidden to the end.

units.source_text: 今天该怎么办呢？

en.t: What should be done today?

units.source_text: 小姐一个人来，反而容易对付。

en.t: Since the young lady has come alone, it will actually be easier to manage.

units.source_text: 你可向小姐传言：‘我俩不期而遇，定有宿世深缘。’”

en.t: You may tell the young lady, 'For the two of us to meet by chance like this, there must surely be a deep bond from a former life.'"

units.source_text: 弁君笑道：“真稀奇啊！

en.t: Ben no Kimi laughed and said, "How very unusual!

units.source_text: 你们这宿缘是几时结成的呀？”

en.t: When was this karmic bond between you two formed?"

units.source_text: 接着又说：“那么，我就向小姐传言吧。”

en.t: Then she added, "In that case, I will deliver the message to the young lady."

units.source_text: 说着回到室内去了。

en.t: With that, she went back inside the room.

units.source_text: 薰大将自言自语地吟诗曰：

en.t: General Kaoru murmured a poem to himself:
